name: Arpenia
summary: Arpenia is an Ayleid ruin in Blackwood, located east of Fort Redmane, containing Whispering Shadows and gloam creatures. A projection of the Duke of Crows can be spoken to outside, and will request your help in freeing members of the Blackfeather Court trapped within the ruins. A cultist note can be found shortly after entering the ruin. Lizards, rats, snakes, spiders and torchbugs are found in numbers within. Hazards include: Swinging Blades
